decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan Dated 12.05.2026;Site Block Plan 400 Dated 12.05.2026;Pre-existing Site Plan 300100 Dated 12.05.2026;Pre-existing Ground Floor Plan 300201 Dated 12.05.2026;Pre-existing First Floor Plan 300202	Dated 12.05.2026;Pre-existing Roof Plan 300203 Dated 12.05.2026;Pre-existing Elevations 300301 Dated 12.05.2026;Pre-existing Sections 300401 Dated 12.05.2026;Existing Site Plan 100100 Dated 12.05.2026;Existing Ground Floor Plan 100201 Dated 12.05.2026;Existing First Floor Plan 100202 Dated 12.05.2026;Existing Roof Plan 100203 Dated 12.05.2026;Existing Elevations 100301 Dated 12.05.2026;Existing Sections 100401 Dated 12.05.2026;Proposed Site Plan 200100 Dated 12.05.2026;Proposed Ground Floor Plan	200201 Dated 12.05.2026;Proposed Ground Floor Garden Plan	 200202 Dated 12.05.2026;Proposed First Floor Plan 200203 Dated 12.05.2026;Proposed Roof Plan 200204 Dated 12.05.2026;Proposed Elevations 200301 Dated 12.05.2026;Proposed Sections 200401 Dated 12.05.2026;Proposed Cycle and Waste Storage Details	200501 Dated 12.05.2026;Proposed Cycle Storage Details 200502 Dated 12.05.2026;Sustainable Drainage Proforma;Highway Safety Impact Assessment;Flood Risk Assessment 207 - N18 2XR Dated 11.05.2026;Flood Map for Planning Dated 11.05.2026;Fire Statement 207 - N18 2XR Dated 11.05.2026;Noise, Disturbance and Antisocial Behaviour Procedure Statement; Design and Access Statement 207 - N18 2XR Dated 11.05.2026.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than FIVE residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect neighbouring residential amenity or the character of the immediate area.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen and dining/living rooms shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Within SIX months from the date of this decision, Cycle parking, shall be provided as indicated on drawing "Proposed Site Plan 200100 dated 12.05.2026", in accordance with the following requirements:o Provision of a minimum of FIVE long stay cycle parking spaces;o in an accessible location; the store door must have a minimum opening width of 1.2mo long stay cycle parking spaces secured with a British Standard mortice lock or access fob;o fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roof.Reason: To ensure the provision of accessible, secure, and adequate cycle parking facilities and to safeguard the character and appearance of the area.

Within SIX months from the date of this decision, waste storage and recycling facilities shall be provided to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site have been provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained permanently thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the amenity of the occupiers of adjoining premises; protect the general environment; prevent any obstruction to pedestrian movement and to ensure that there are adequate facilities for the storage and recycling of recoverable materials.
description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class C4 (HMO-house in multiple occupation) with associated amenity, cycle and refuse storage (PART-RETROSPECTIVE).
